title: Witness drawing of disc-shaped craft over fence and house, Case 20264
description: Pen drawing captioned "Drawing done by witness Case 20264" showing a wide domed saucer with dark and cross-hatched panels, a row of rectangular windows and a shaded underside, hovering above a wooden picket fence between a tree and a house. Annotations read "Loud Roaring Sound Similar to Rocket," "white lights" on both sides, "[20ft]" and "2 story high."
